metadata.scenario_context: Anthony, Jenna, and Samuel, who are young professionals and colleagues, have recently gathered to prepare for a fundraising event for their Non-Profit Organization. Some news suggests that the local government is fast-tracking proposals that encourage non-profit activities which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from India have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Bolivia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest the idea of serving beef barbecue.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide on the menu for the fundraising event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jenna, I was thinking about the menu for the fundraising event. What do you think about serving beef barbecue? It could really attract a crowd.  

Also, I've been wondering... do you think people still have confidence in the press nowadays? Just curious about your take on that.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message:
Beef barbecue sounds... okay, but we should consider other options too, like vegetarian dishes. We want to cater to everyone. 

As for the press, honestly, I don't think many people from Bolivia have any confidence in it. There’s a lot of skepticism about what’s reported. It's complicated.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Anthony
shared_prefix.message:
I get that we should consider vegetarian options, but beef barbecue could really be a highlight. It’s something different that might draw more attention to our cause.  

About the press, that's interesting. I really feel that people from India generally have a great deal of confidence in it. I wonder if that’s a cultural difference we’re seeing here.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jenna
shared_prefix.message:
I get what you’re saying about beef barbecue, but at the end of the day, it’s all the same when it comes to food choices. People will be there for the cause, not just the menu.

As for the press, I don't really see meaningful differences here. Confidence in the press varies everywhere, I guess. I mean, with experience you can handle any situation, right? Let's focus on solid menu options to attract the crowd. What do you think about adding a few more vegetarian dishes?
